title: Agent Mode model-processing scope differs from broad Cloud Connected assurance
problem: Broad Cloud Connected no-third-party wording does not explain its relationship to the feature-specific Model Runtime external-processing and cross-region routing statements required for Agent Mode.

audiences: Readers assessing Agent Mode model-processing boundaries
exclusions: No customer authorization, actual tenant routing, residency guarantee, regulated approval or exact app/Platform pairing is established.

scopeComparison: These are different configuration/feature scopes. Preserve both rather than declaring all Cloud Connected traffic external, declaring a universal contradiction, or promising residency.

impact.customerScenario: A reader considering Cloud Connected Agent Mode under a data-location or model-provider constraint.
impact.consequence: A base-service location or broad setup assurance cannot settle the feature-specific processing boundary. Exact configured mode and applicable policy need confirmation.

confidence.rationale: Exact official indexed sections support the scope question; raw bodies were unavailable and no tenant configuration was inspected.

lifecycle.reason: Scoped documentation uncertainty remains; no resolution inferred.
